page.overview:
What is Theodore?

Theodore is an animatronic rabbit and was the first toy built by Henry for his daughter, Charlotte Emily. He sat alone in Charlie's room for years after Henry's death, becoming damaged by the elements. When Charlie moved to St. George for college, she reclaimed Theodore in order to study him and use his parts for an experiment.

The Ultimate Guide Description: "A small purple rabbit animatronic created by Henry for Charlie. It could wave, tilt its head, and repeat a recording from Henry saying 'I love you, Charlie.' Charlie later takes Theodore apart for her robotics project."

Theodore is a dark purple rabbit the size of a three-year-old child with shining plastic eyes, a cotton-ball tail, a dapper red bow tie, and thin, plush threadbare fur. He also had a button at the base of his neck. When Charlie returns to her father's house, Theodore's front is now gray with age from years of sitting in the sunlight and one of his long floppy ears hangs loose by a single rotting thread, the green plastic of his circuit board visible through the hole. In The Twisted Ones, he gets taken apart and used for Charlie's project.

In The Freddy Files, Theodore is depicted with uneven blue eyes, red cheeks, and a light pink pad on the palms of his hands and feet. He sports a pair of teeth on both his upper and lower jaw, which later becomes chipped due to years of deterioration. The graphic novel uses a similar depiction, although Theodore's fur appears more pink and he only has two front teeth. He's also notably less damaged.
